blurb: `==` on text stops at the first character that differs, so how long it takes tells a caller how much of a guess was right. A `bynk` `Secret` is therefore never compared with `==` or `!=`, nor held in a type that is (a record or sum that derives equality). Compare with `secret.matches(candidate)`, which takes the same time however the two differ, or call `reveal()` where the text itself is needed.
summary: `==` or `!=` on a `bynk` `Secret`, or on a type that holds one: comparing text is variable-time, so a secret is compared with `matches` (#4111).
